lines.prompt: Derive the Boolean equation for output n7. Express it in terms of the primary inputs.

golden.reference: n7 = ~(n6[7] | n6[6] | n6[5] | n6[4] | n6[3] | n6[2] | n6[1] | n6[0]), i.e. n7 = 1 iff all bits of register bus n6[7:0] are 0 (equivalently the AND of all complements !n6[0]&...&!n6[7]).
golden.notes: All four teams give logically equivalent equations. Team2/Team3/Team4 give the structural nested form ~((n6[6]|n6[5])|(n6[4]|(n6[7]|~(~(n6[3]|n6[2])&~(n6[1]|n6[0]))))); Team7 gives the flattened product-of-complements form. Both simplify to NOR of n6[7:0]. Note all full-score teams express n7 in terms of register outputs n6[*] treated as primary inputs for combinational analysis (contest convention) — accept any logically equivalent expression over n6[7:0].

team_answers.Team3: n7 = ~((n6[6] | n6[5]) | (n6[4] | (n6[7] | ~(~(n6[3] | n6[2]) & ~(n6[1] | n6[0]))))) (same nested NOR form; log renders OR/AND as \lor/\land)
